# Leaflet 1.9.4

Local unmodified distribution files, downloaded from:

- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js
- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/v1.9.4/LICENSE

See LICENSE for the upstream BSD license. Tracking uses circle markers, so the
optional default marker image assets are not used. Map tiles are requested by the
browser only when a signed-in viewer opens a stored delivery map.
